summary: Audio system testing complete. Fixed critical bug where audio elements were not being created. All public profile audio functionality now working correctly.
passed_tests: NO autoplay on page load - audio only starts after user tap on activation button
Audio files (activation.mp3, amb_sensuale.mp3, etc.) are served correctly (HTTP 200)
Tap on 'NON DOVRESTI PREMERLO' button unlocks audio and plays activation sound + ambient music
Ambient music enters with fade-in (~2.4s) and loops correctly
Toggle sound OFF (🔇) stops ambient music with fade-out
Toggle sound ON (🔊) while in Secret Side restarts ambient music with fade-in
Revert to Public Side stops ambient music with fade-out
Model change (navigation to different profile) cleans up audio elements - no double audio
No unhandled promise rejections from play() calls - robust error handling
Visual transformation (blackout, reveal, secret ambience) still works correctly
No ReferenceError for old functions (playSwitch/playWhoosh/playImpact removed)
Admin audio controls present in code (traccia select, volume sliders, preview button)

critical_fix_applied.issue: Audio elements were not being created because HTMLAudioElement instances were not appended to the DOM, causing them to be garbage collected or not load properly
critical_fix_applied.fix: Modified _make() method in sound.js to append audio elements to document.body with display:none

test_results.no_autoplay: PASS - 0 audio elements on page load, 0 playing
test_results.activation_triggers_audio: PASS - 2 audio elements created (activation + ambient), ambient playing with fade-in
test_results.toggle_mute_off: PASS - ambient paused when sound toggled OFF
test_results.toggle_mute_on: PASS - ambient resumed when sound toggled ON
test_results.revert_stops_audio: PASS - ambient paused when returning to Public Side
test_results.model_change_cleanup: PASS - 0 audio elements after navigation, 2 elements after activation on new model (no double audio)
test_results.visual_regression: PASS - secret ambience and blackout overlay present

detailed_findings.ios_compatibility_notes: Testing performed on Chromium (desktop). The implementation uses HTMLAudioElement with proper iOS-friendly attributes (playsinline, playsInline). Audio unlock is performed inside user gesture (tap on activation button) which is the correct approach for iOS Safari. The logic should work on real iOS devices, though full iOS testing would require a real device or iOS simulator.
detailed_findings.admin_controls_status: Admin audio controls are properly implemented in ModelEditor.js (lines 326-352) with data-testids for traccia select, volume sliders, and preview button. Preview functionality uses the preview() method in sound.js (lines 123-139). Could not test admin UI due to routing issue, but code review confirms proper implementation.
